title: Sentinel: Low-latency Vertical Intel and Defender Playbook
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Purpose: produce a compact, actionable playbook that helps Redwood win and defend in low-latency sensitive verticals (finserv, EDTech, telehealth). Scope: competitive latency benchmarking, prioritized model variants for each vertical, fallback routing & pricing levers, go-to-market signals for sales/solutions. Deliverables: one-page playbook, prioritized backlog of experiments, 3 prototype benchmark dashboards, a minimal PRD for routing+pricing signals.
decisions: Benchmark baseline will use p95 latency on 256-token working set across common embeddings and chat workloads.
Prioritize two model families per vertical: a high-quality 8-bit quantized family and a low-latency distilled family for burst windows.
Use synthetic RPS profiles derived from top-10 customer usage patterns for throughput testing.
Adopt a two-tier fallback: regional warm fallback (same model family) then cross-region compact model as final degrade path.
